criteria.requirement: Implement cli_helpers.tabular_output.projection.select_columns(data,headers,selection) returning (lazy_rows,projected_headers). Materialize finite headers once and validate ordered integer indices or unique string column names before row consumption. Preserve duplicate selected positions and exact raw values; reject ambiguous/missing names, bool/negative/out-of-range indices and malformed row widths with one-based row number. Do not mutate or stringify inputs. Project before the existing formatter so its type inference applies to the selected/reordered columns; verify JSON and delimited pipeline integration.
必须交付授权源码、能在原版失败的公开回归和中文兼容说明；所有冻结原生回归通过。

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
